description: This Java class provides helper methods for managing production runs within the manufacturing module of the OFBiz framework. It includes functions to retrieve production run details, check for specific tasks, find linked production runs, and determine the root production run in a dependency chain.

classes.name: ProductionRunHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing production runs, including retrieval, linking, and hierarchy determination.

methods.name: getProductionRun
methods.description: Retrieves details of a production run, including associated product, components, and routing tasks.

methods.name: hasTask
methods.description: Checks if a specific task exists within a production work effort.

methods.name: getLinkedProductionRuns
methods.description: Recursively collects all production runs linked via precedence relationships.

methods.name: getRootProductionRun
methods.description: Finds the root production run in a chain of linked production efforts.
